sources.title: XRP ETF flows, holdings and Q2 2026 institutional holders
claims: Five US spot XRP ETFs are tracked, with series start 2025-11-14.
For 2026-10-30, the displayed XRP ETF net flow was +USD 0.2M, but only 3 of 5 funds had reported; XRPZ and GXRP were pending. XRPC reported +USD 0.9M, Bitwise XRP -USD 0.7M and TOXR zero.
The same page reports a two-day inflow streak totaling +USD 8.7M, 30-trading-day net inflow +USD 146.6M, YTD net inflow +USD 649.2M, cumulative net inflow +USD 1.82B and net assets USD 1.42B.
The five funds reported holdings of 1,142,785,690 XRP at 2026-10-30, approximately 1.80% of circulating supply.

Q2 2026 13F aggregation reports 127 institutions holding USD 179M across five XRP ETFs as of 2026-06-30; Goldman Sachs USD 86.5M, Jane Street USD 16.4M, Millennium Management USD 16.2M and Intesa Sanpaolo USD 14.4M.
limitations: The 2026-10-30 daily flow is explicitly partial: XRPZ and GXRP had not reported; pending is not zero.
13F positions are lagged long positions at quarter end, not current holdings, beneficial ownership of XRP or complete exposure; shorts, futures and retail positions are excluded.
ETF creations/redemptions settle with a lag and may reflect AP arbitrage/hedging rather than same-day directional demand.
All flow and 13F aggregation claims on this page share one provider/methodology and are not independent source confirmations.

sources.title: FOMC statement — October 28, 2026
claims: The FOMC voted 10–2 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3.75%–4.00%.
Both dissenters, Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack, preferred a 25-basis-point increase at that meeting.
The statement says economic activity is expanding at a strong pace, inflation remains elevated and uncertainty remains elevated partly due to geopolitical developments.
limitations: The statement is macroeconomic context, not an XRP-specific causal explanation.
Two hawkish dissents do not determine the future policy path; subsequent data and decisions can change the outlook.
